additional_info.subject: ID0453104-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001685] IMD_BC1 error CRM:00315003039
additional_info.body:
Hello Richard, good evening. I hope you are doing well.
Can you please let me know if you are trained to perform any tasks on the charger physically? This task cannot be resolved remotely as there seems to be a isolation problem or simply a cable issue.
Can you please tell me if you face the same error with IMD BC2? If BC2 is working, we can try swapping BC1 and BC2 to understand if the component is faulty or if there is actually an isolation problem/cabling issue.
I will wait for your feedback before providing a guide.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453104-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001685] IMD_BC1 error CRM:00315003039
additional_info.body:
Hi,
The owner of the charger is one of our customers, they are able to carry out the work. If needed, they can use a local partner company of e-mobility in Singapore.
I will let them check as per your advice below.
Regards
Richard Harvey

additional_info.subject: ID0453104-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001685] IMD_BC1 error CRM:00315003039
additional_info.body:
Hi Richard, good afternoon.
Thanks for the feedback.
From my perspective, if the BC2 is working (has 2MOhm) and BC1 is still like this, I assume that there can be only one of 2 possibilities:
BC1 is not working properly
There is some kind of component/material/etc. touching the busbars of the DC1 circuit.
For this please look visually inside the charger (turned off!!!) and see if you can find anything that might be touching it.
Please proceed with the trial of swapping BC1 and BC2 if the BC2 is working accordingly:
If the problem is now on the BC2, then it means there is something on the circuit
If the problem is still in BC1, please replace it with the new one and configure it.
Please change all the values to the yellow marked ones, since it's a BC1, from scratch is already comes with the Modbus address to 3 which is the correct one, so there is no need to change this particular configuration.
I will wait for your feedback on this subject.
Thanks a lot and have a nice day.
Best regards,
Francisco
